subject: Seraphic trial: guardrails, KPIs & next steps
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@seraphicai.com>, Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@seraphicai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Seraphic trial: guardrails, KPIs & next steps

Hi Alicia / Tom —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and a concrete POC proposal so we can move to a kickoff next week. High-level Seraphic ask: evaluate Redwood Inference for production customer-support summarization and reply-suggest features. Goals we heard: reduce human review time, keep hallucination low, and achieve predictable cost-per-response.

Proposed trial: 4-week functional trial (production-like traffic replay + live shadowing) with the following success criteria and evaluation plan. Please confirm acceptability or suggest edits.

Success criteria (proposed):
- Latency: p95 generation latency <= 250 ms for 512-token average prompt (target; can negotiate)
- Throughput: sustain 25 req/sec steady-state with <5% queuing at the edge
- Cost: amortized cost/token <= $0.0008 (model + infra) on the observed workload profile
- Quality: end-to-end accept rate >= 85% on the Seraphic curated validation set (N=500), and hallucination incidence < 2% on random sample

Evaluation plan / acceptance tests:
1) Week 0 (kickoff): baseline data drop and access to sample logs / evaluation set (Seraphic provides).
2) Week 1: deploy model variant A (standard quant) with prefix caching; run replay ingest at 1x expected load and collect telemetry.
3) Week 2: run ramp to 2x + failure-mode tests (region failover, model fallback).
4) Week 3: human-in-the-loop rating on 500 items (Seraphic reviewers + Redwood eval script) -> compute accept rate, latency percentiles, cost profile.
5) Week 4: sharpen config, hand-off report, and final acceptance decision.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Logan (trial lead), Dylan (SRE/serving), Marissa (CS & onboarding)
- Seraphic: Alicia (product), Tom (infra)

Docs / attachments: I attached a lightweight POC template (seraphic_poc_template.xlsx) and added a shared Drive link with the evaluation rubric.

Next steps (requested):
- Confirm the success thresholds above or propose alternatives by Mon 7/12
- Sign POC SOW (I’ll send DocuSign if you’re ok)
- Kickoff Wed 7/14 10am PT — 30m (tentative)

If you prefer a slightly looser latency target I can update the plan — just call it out.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Logan Wright
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: seraphic_poc_template.xlsx

From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@seraphicai.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reeves <tom.reeves@seraphicai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 17:35:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Seraphic trial: guardrails, KPIs & next steps

Thanks Logan — this is very helpful and clear. A few comments from our side after internal sync: 

- Latency: we can accept p95 <= 300 ms (512-token baseline) instead of 250; our primary constraint is user-perceived snappiness.
- Throughput: 25 rps looks right for steady-state; we'll plan a staged ramp (week 1 at 0.5x, week 2 at 1x, week 3 at 2x) — would like Redwood to validate queuing behavior at each step.
- Cost: the $0.0008/token target is fine as a planning goal; we'll want a per-test-case cost breakdown during Week 3.
- Quality: we'll provide the 500-item validation set next business day. For hallucination measurement we use conservative labeling; Redwood’s eval script should output a hallucination flag per sample.

Also, security will run a light questionnaire before kickoff (I attached the PDF). Can you confirm whether Redwood needs inbound IP whitelisting for private connections or if we'll use your hosted endpoints?

DocuSign for the POC SOW sounds good — please send. Confirming tentative kickoff window: Wed 7/14 10am PT works for Alicia and Tom.

Appreciate the clarity — we’ll aim to sign by Mon 7/12 and drop the eval set.

—Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Product Lead, Integrations
Seraphic AI

Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf

From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@seraphicai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 09:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Seraphic trial: guardrails, KPIs & next steps

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Alicia — perfect. Per your feedback I’m updating the plan and pulling together a short acceptance checklist that we’ll use during Week 3. Summary of adjustments below: 

Updated success criteria (confirmed):
- Latency: p95 <= 300 ms (512-token baseline)
- Throughput: steady-state 25 rps, validated at each ramp step (0.5x, 1x, 2x)
- Cost: target $0.0008/token (reporting by test-case)
- Quality: >= 85% accept rate on Seraphic’s 500-item set; hallucination <= 2%

Operational notes / asks from Redwood: 
- Endpoint model: we can run on Redwood hosted endpoints for the trial (no inbound IP whitelisting required). If you prefer VPC/private mode later we’ll schedule a separate network onboarding.
- Telemetry we need: request_id, client_timestamp, prompt_length, response_length, model_variant, node_latency_ms. We’ll provide a schema and a lightweight collector (trial_config_v2.yaml attached).
- Human eval: Redwood will provide a small eval UI and CSV checklist (poc_kpi_checklist.csv) for your reviewers. We’ll share results daily during Week 3.

DocuSign: SOW sent via DocuSign (link included below). Please sign by EOD Mon 7/12 to keep the 7/14 kickoff.

Owners (final):
- Redwood: Logan (trial lead, communications), Dylan (serving infra & ramp validation), Marissa (onboarding & reviewer coordination)
- Seraphic: Alicia (product), Tom (infra), QA team (human eval)

Next steps:
1) Seraphic: sign DocuSign SOW (link) and drop validation set + sample logs by EOD Mon 7/12
2) Redwood: send trial config, onboarding steps, and calendar invite for 7/14 10am PT

I’ve attached the trial_config_v2.yaml with the telemetry and rollout knobs we’ll use. If that looks good I’ll have Dylan provision the trial and Marissa will send the evaluator invites.

Thanks — we’ll be ready to go once the SOW and data are in.

Best,
Logan

Attachments: trial_config_v2.yaml, poc_kpi_checklist.csv

Related links: https://www.docusign.com/signed/abc123-trial-sow
